Loss report: gitea -> woodpecker
[lost] pipeline/ci display.name (the Woodpecker workflow name is its file name; the display name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gha (events, run-name) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.shell (Woodpecker runs commands in the image shell, not bash)
[external] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner: no backend label (the hosted label ubuntu-latest runs on any Linux worker; the GitHub-hosted image tools are not present)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
